title: Naam lands where mercy opens the hand first.
summary: Grace is not sentimental decoration. It is the condition that makes lasting remembrance possible.
takeaway: Do not try to earn what must first be given.
lifeApplication: When you feel spiritually behind, ask for mercy before you ask for intensity.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy gives Naam and even reunites what has wandered.
source.lifeApplication: Return is possible because grace precedes your recovery.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy gives Naam and even reunites what has wandered.
evidence.turn: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel spiritually behind, ask for mercy before you ask for intensity.
